ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicare fraud across the country, including the latest cases and arrests.
questions: What is the scope of Medicare fraud across the country?
How are individuals and organizations defrauding the system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale issue with significant financial implications. By following the money and investigating the latest cases, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and potential solutions.
